_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Not knowing short lines for asking the way

segments.text: Lost in a new city? Here are four easy lines. Repeat after me.

native.caption: هل تتردد في السؤال عن الطريق بالإنجليزية؟ احفظ هذه الجمل الأربع: “Where is the bus stop?”، “How far is it?”، “Is it near here?”، “Can you help me, please?”. استمع إلى المعلمة Ama ثم كرّر في لحظة الصمت. تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.hook: How do you ask for directions in English?
en.caption: Do you hesitate to ask for directions in English? Save these 4 lines: “Where is the bus stop?”, “How far is it?”, “Is it near here?”, “Can you help me, please?”. Listen to Ama, then say each one in the pause. Practice more in the Lexkite app.
